title: Liquidity pool interest accrual can be manipulated
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  On each call to the `borrow` method of the `LiquidityPool` contract, the subsequent `_fixAccruedInterest` method is invoked which updates the `totalBorrowsSnapshotTimestamp` to the current `block.timestamp`. In case of frequent calls, this causes the `ownershipTime` in the `totalBorrows` method to have a low value (worst case: 1) which in turn leads to a precision loss in the final `totalBorrows` / interest snapshot computation.
